headline: Brand Designer
tagline: Brand designer experienced in visual systems, print production, and end-to-end brand identity rollouts.

skills.label: Design & Branding
skills.items: Branding and visual identity, Typography, Layout, Print production, Social/marketing creative

skills.label: Tools

skills.label: Process
skills.items: Print-ready file management (bleed, sizing, colour accuracy), Stakeholder management, Design systems

Created social campaigns, branding assets, and brochures for startups and SMBs
Conducted usability testing, feeding findings back into user flows and interface usability
Collaborated with developers and stakeholders on design-to-development handoff

projects.name: Fashion Brand Social Campaign
